### YouTube Description

What if better skin, balanced hormones, and long-term wellness all started in the gut?

In this episode of *The Aesthetic and Wellness Edge*, host Bethany Gifford sits down with David Finkelstein, Chief Marketing Officer of Doctors Biome, to explore the powerful connection between gut health, aesthetics, hormones, and longevity.

Doctors Biome is redefining probiotics with living, liquid formulations that are alive, growing, and delivered in organic juices that act as both probiotic and prebiotic sources. Unlike capsules or powders, these probiotics are already living when consumed, helping them survive the digestive system and support the gut at a deeper level.

In this conversation, we cover:
- Why most probiotics fail to deliver consistent results  
- What makes living liquid probiotics different from capsules and powders  
- How gut health influences skin clarity, hormones, and whole body wellness  
- The science behind Doctors Biome and its multi year research and development  
- Why med spas and wellness clinics are integrating gut health into their services  
- The future of inside out wellness and provider partnerships  

This episode is a must listen for med spa owners, wellness practitioners, and anyone interested in improving health, beauty, and longevity from the inside out.

🔗 Learn more about Doctors Biome: https://www.doctorsbiome.com

If you enjoyed this episode, be sure to subscribe, leave a review, and share it with someone passionate about functional health and aesthetics.
